messages:
sara.support: FYI customer org 'acme-ride' (org_204) escalated: TTFT and tokens/sec on Console streaming dashboard dropped to 0 around 09:12 UTC, then briefly went negative (-120) for ~3m. They're seeing billing blips + alert noise. Logs attached.
omar.eng: thx. any request ids or traces? is this hosted only or also dedicated?
sara.support: hosted only. trace id 8f3a2b7e, example req ids: rc-1001, rc-1002. Customer reports multiple routes affected (chat.stream). Graph goes flat then below 0.
jinny-ml: possible: aggregation window miscounting when ingestion timestamps arrive out of order. saw similar once when a Kafka partition timestamp jumped. can you paste the PromQL you used?
sara.support: here's what Console debug returns: 
```promql
rate(streaming_tokens_total{org=\"org_204\"}[1m]) or vector(0)
```
# sample results we saw: 0, 0, -120, -130, 0
dave-sre: negative tokens/sec almost always means a counter decrease/reset or bad join between series. could be counter scraped with different labels or a timestamp regression. check streaming-metrics-ingestor logs and kafka offsets.
deploy-bot: streaming-metrics-ingestor v2 deployed at 2025-06-24T09:10:50Z by @elaine-ops :rocket:
elaine-ops: we rolled v2 (canary->all) between 09:10-09:15 to address latency; will grep hosts for clock/ntp errors.
omar.eng: pulling ingestor logs now, seeing repeated WARN: \"kafka timestamp older than previous\" and an aggregator error: 
```text
ingestor/main.go:312: aggregation window start > last_ts, delta = -3600
metrics/aggregator.go:47: negative_delta encountered
```
jinny-ml: that stacktrace + delta -3600 looks like a wall-clock jump backwards (~1h). if the aggregator does naive current_ts - last_ts to compute tokens/sec, a negative delta will produce negative rates. we should clamp negative deltas to 0.
dave-sre: agreed. pushed a hotfix to aggregator to clamp negative deltas and restarted ingestor on hosts 12-15. monitoring now — please watch the streaming dashboard for recurrence over the next 10m.
sara.support: customer confirmed graphs moving back to normal at ~09:21 UTC. they're asking for RCA + impact window.
omar.eng: action items: 1) RCA: root cause = transient NTP/clock drift during canary rollout causing backward timestamps from the ingestor host, 2) mitigation: hotfix deployed to clamp negatives, 3) instrumentation: add alert for negative-rate occurrences and record last_ts deltas, 4) data fix: backfill affected 10m windows in Console (recompute aggregates).
jinny-ml: repro steps for QA:
- run a canary ingestor and simulate backwards timestamps (mock ts -3600s)
- stream events at ~1k tokens/min
- validate Dashboard shows clamped 0 instead of negatives and no billing anomalies
sara.support: I'll follow up with the customer, attach incident INC-2025-241, and share ETA for backfill. thanks everyone :heart:
dave-sre: :thumbsup: will close this thread after backfill completes and RCA doc is in confluence (link forthcoming).
